title: Dispersion and Sintering Behavior of Hybrid Al7075 Composites Reinforced with TiC and TaC Processed by Mechanical Alloying and High-Frequency Induction Sintering
content: Hybrid metallic composites represent an advanced approach in the design of reinforced materials, incorporating multiple ceramic phases into a metallic matrix to enhance overall performance. Specifically, the addition of TiC and TaC carbides to the Al7075 alloy leverages the synergistic properties of both reinforcements, improving the material’s mechanical response and thermal stability through hardening mechanisms and microstructural stabilization. This work studies the synthesis of hybrid Al7075 composites reinforced with TiC and TaC. It is investigated the dispersion of these phases through mechanical alloying and their consolidation via high-frequency induction sintering. The aim is to observe the effect of these strengthening phases on the microstructure and hardness performance of the composites.
